# PaperSize

```csharp
public enum PaperSize
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

The paper a sheet prints on, by the number Excel stores (as its `XlPaperSize` does). A file may hold a number not named here, from a printer's own sizes; it is kept as it is.
